_note: Boxes are NORMALISED to the tile (0-1). The inhabited tile: a thatched hall with figures at the top left, and the widest variety of leaf grammar in z3w -- round clusters, brick dashes, and rows of tiny dark conifers that are DISTANT MARKS, not trees to rig.

objects.name: thatched hall at the top left
objects.note: ruled architectural lines. A building NEVER deforms -- any wobble in it destroys the whole illusion, so it must sit rigid on its own plane

objects.name: second figure at the hall door
pink and rust tree beside the hall
objects.note: sits directly against the building -- must not drag the roofline with it

objects.name: grove of slim teal trees on the left terrace
objects.note: several thin trunks with small crowns; rig as a group, small swing

objects.name: row of small dark conifers across the mid left
objects.note: DISTANT MARKS, not trees. At this size a hinge produces visible jitter and no readable motion -- leave still. This is the class that made canopy-by-texture-statistics fail

objects.name: teal pine on the upper ridge
objects.note: clean separated clusters despite the distance

objects.name: cluster of dark conifers on the far ridge
rust brick-mark tree in the centre
objects.note: leaves drawn as short horizontal dashes in tight rows -- the same grammar as t010's bottom thicket

objects.name: teal round-leaf tree below and right of it
objects.note: overlaps the brick tree; cut the crowns apart before hinging or they swing as one slab

objects.name: rust and orange tree at the top right
objects.note: clipped; continues into the tile to the right

objects.name: teal canopy at the right edge
row of dark conifers on the right slope
grove of teal and rust trees across the bottom right
objects.note: the nearest foliage in the tile and the largest leaf marks; several distinct crowns on ochre trunks

objects.name: teal tree at the bottom centre
fence rail at the bottom left
objects.note: ruled lines; rigid like the hall

objects.name: the broad pale slope through the middle
objects.note: nearly bare silk; a good clean-plate donor

objects.name: ridge across the top right
objects.note: the far plane the conifer rows sit on
